meanings.usage: 指叙述性的事件，可真实或虚构
表示情况发生得很意外、迅速
指不悦耳的声音或嘈杂声
表示向楼下或位于楼下的位置

phrases.usage: 用于强调故事是真实的而非虚构的

examples.en: I want to tell you a true story.
examples.zh: 我想给你讲一个真实的故事。

phrases.usage: 表示某人是说话者的朋友之一

examples.en: It happened to a friend of mine.
examples.zh: 它发生在我一个朋友身上。

phrases.usage: 表示爬进（较小的空间或物体内部）

examples.en: Two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
examples.zh: 两个贼爬进了他的厨房。

phrases.usage: 表示打开（电器、灯、水龙头等）
口语中常用的问候语，意为'怎么了？'或'有什么事？'
表示尽可能快地，强调尽最大努力

examples.en: The thieves ran away as quickly as they could.
George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
examples.zh: 乔治听到声音后迅速下楼。

phrases.usage: 指向某人大声喊叫或叫喊

examples.en: Who called out to the thieves in the dark?
examples.zh: 谁在黑暗中向贼们大声喊叫？

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作 用于描述过去的背景动作，常与when/while/as引导的时间状语连用

examples.en: While my friend was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
examples.zh: 当我的朋友躺在床上看书时，两个贼爬进了他的厨房。

examples.en: George was reading when the thieves entered.
examples.zh: 贼进入时乔治正在看书。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去' 用于描述在另一个过去动作之前发生的动作，常与after/before/when等连用

examples.en: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room.
examples.zh: 他们进入房子之后，走进了餐厅。

examples.en: The thieves had already gone when George came downstairs.
examples.zh: 乔治下楼时贼们已经跑了。

grammar.title: 过去进行时与过去完成时的区别
grammar.structure: 过去进行时: was/were + doing / 过去完成时: had + done
grammar.definition: 过去进行时强调动作在进行中，过去完成时强调动作已经完成 过去进行时通常作背景（持续性动作），过去完成时作主要事件（已完成动作）

examples.en: While George was reading (背景动作), the thieves entered (主要动作).
examples.zh: 当乔治正在看书时（进行中的背景动作），贼们进来了（主要动作）。

examples.en: After they had entered (过去的过去), they went into the dining room.
examples.zh: 在他们进入之后（过去的过去），他们走进餐厅。

patterns.pattern: While + 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing...

original.en: While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
original.zh: 当我的朋友乔治躺在床上看书时，两个贼爬进了他的厨房。

imitations.en: While I was cooking dinner, the phone rang.
imitations.zh: 当我正在做晚饭时，电话响了。

imitations.en: While she was sleeping, someone knocked at the door.
imitations.zh: 当她正在睡觉时，有人敲门。

patterns.pattern: After + 主语 + had + 过去分词...

original.en: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room.
original.zh: 他们进入房子之后，走进了餐厅。

imitations.en: After I had finished my homework, I watched TV.
imitations.zh: 我完成作业之后看了电视。

imitations.en: After he had left, we started the meeting.
imitations.zh: 他离开之后，我们开始了会议。

patterns.pattern: ...as + 副词最高级 + as + 主语 + could

original.en: The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
original.zh: 贼们扔下手电筒尽快地逃跑了。

imitations.en: She ran as fast as she could to catch the bus.
imitations.zh: 她尽快地跑着去赶公交车。

imitations.en: They worked as hard as they could to finish the project.
imitations.zh: 他们尽可能努力地工作以完成项目。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + turn on/off + 宾语

imitations.en: He turned off the TV before leaving.

lines.en: Do you like stories? I want to tell you a true story. It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen. After they had entered the house, they went into the dining-room. It was very dark, so they turned on a torch
George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly. He turned on the light, but he couldn’t see anyone. The thieves had already gone. But George’s parrot, Henry, was still there.
“What’s up, George?” he called.
“Nothing, Henry,” George said and smiled.
“Go back to sleep.”
He dropped the vase after he had taken it into the living room.
He bought another car after he had sold his old one.
He swept the floor after he had dusted everything.
She drank the milk after she had boiled it.
He turned off the television after he had seen the programme
He went to bed after he had done his homework.
B Yes, I have just seen it. I had never seen it before.
Yes, I have just read it. I had never read it before.
Yes, I have just tried it. I had never tried it before.
Yes, I have just been there. I had never been there before.
Yes, I have just written a letter in English. I had never written a letter in English before.
Yes, I have just watched this programme. I had never watched this programme before.
C It was too late. He had already painted it.
It was too late. She had already dusted it.
It was too late. You had already telephoned him.
It was too late. You had already corrected it.
It was too late. They had already shut it.
It was too late. She had already made it.
D I went to the doctor after I had made an appointment
The boss left the office after he had finished work.
My wife went out after she had finished the housework.
My teacher gave me my exercise book after he had corrected it.
My sister went on holiday after she had taken the examination
I bought a new car after I had sold my old one.

questions.q: Who called out to the thieves in the dark?

translation:
你喜欢听故事吗？我要告诉你一个真实的故事。这是一年前发生在我的一个朋友身上的故事。
当我的朋友乔治在床上看书时，两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。
他们进到屋里后，走进了饭厅。饭厅很暗，于是他们打开了手电筒。
突然他们听到身后有声音。“什么事？什么事？”有人叫着。小偷扔下了手电筒，飞快地逃走了。
乔治听到了响声，迅速地下了楼。
他开了灯，但不见一个人。小偷逃走了。
但时乔治的鹦鹉亨利仍在那里。“什么事，乔治？”它叫着。“没事，亨利。”乔治笑着说，“接着睡觉吧。”
